रामकथा के दीवानों, तैयार हो जाओ क्योंकि बॉक्स ऑफिस पर आने वाला है महातूफान! 🌪️

रणबीर कपूर और यश स्टारर फिल्म Ramayana Part One को लेकर विदेश से बहुत तगड़ी खबर सामने आ रही है।
रिपोर्ट्स के मुताबिक इस फिल्म की overseas advance sales बहुत शानदार चल रही है।
फिल्म का opening weekend USD 20M+ यानी बीस मिलियन डॉलर से ज्यादा रहने की पूरी उम्मीद जताई जा रही है।
इसके अलावा नेशनल चेन्स में भी फिल्म ने पहले दिन के लिए 1.33 लाख टिकट बेच दिए हैं।
क्या आप इस माइथोलॉजिकल एपिक को देखने के लिए थिएटर जा रहे हैं? 🎬

ctx.title: Ramayana Part One has Excellent Advance Sales Overseas: Ranbir Kapoor, Yash starrer poised for USD 20M+ opening weekend
ctx.summary:
Ramayana: Part One has been on sale overseas for over two weeks now. As of Thursday, the film has raked in USD 2.85 million / Rs. 27 crore approx in international markets for its opening weekend. Around half of that total has come from opening day alone, including USD 875,000 from Wednesday previews in North America. Notably, the film is yet to go on sale in the Middle East, one of the biggest overseas markets for Indian cinema. 
 Comparing these sales with other films, the two best comps are Dhurandhar: The Revenge and Jawan, which had the best pre-sales for a Bollywood film. On one hand, Ramayana trails Dhurandhar by around 25 per cent, but on the other, it is almost 80 per cent higher than Jawan sans Middle East. Dhurandhar: The Revenge had immense initial value, probably the best since Dhoom 3 and Baahubali 2, which gave it phenomenal presales. It opened to USD 21.25 million over a four-day weekend earlier this year, while Jawan debuted with USD 21 million in 2023. Dhurandhar: The Revenge wasn’t allowed a release in the Middle East, which was a big miss, while Jawan outperformed in the territory with a USD 7.10 million opening. 
 The best response to presales is seen in the United States, where the film is closing in on the USD 2 million mark for the weekend. Here it is behind Dhurandhar 2 by about 15-20 per cent but almost 150 per cent ahead of Jawan.
